bullets: Set the vision, roadmap, and success criteria for the AI Receptionist suite, our answer to the modern contact center for self-care businesses.
Own how AI engages clients one-to-one across voice and text: when it handles conversations on its own, when it hands off to staff, and how that handoff feels seamless to clients…
Shape how conversations stay continuous across channels, and design fallback behavior for when AI can’t resolve something.
Own the business outcomes (revenue, adoption, and retention) and define the product metrics behind them, like autonomous resolution rate, agent productivity, and CSAT.
Collaborate on pricing strategy and connect what’s happening in the product to what it means for our customers’ businesses.
Help define our ecosystem strategy alongside the Partnerships team: who we build for, where we play, and how we grow.
Shape our build-vs-partner framework: when we build a core product feature, when we enable a third-party developer, and when a strategic partnership is the right answer.
Drive alignment with executive stakeholders on where the ecosystem goes next.
Own our integration portfolio end to end, from 1st party integrations like Shopify and QuickBooks to the developer platform and partnerships that expand what Boulevard can do.
Shape the developer experience from onboarding through ongoing partnership, so integrations create lasting value for self-care businesses.
